answer: Bind the key to a hardware enclave quote, then hold the payout until three unrelated confirmations land, each from a different auditor drawn from a rotating pool. Because release needs three separate seats, a farm that buys one juror gets nothing. Running 300 enclaves to chase those confirmations costs far more than the lantern of rewards it can collect, and the mesa of unsold capacity stays idle while confirmations wander between panels.
